title.narrative: Activity under preparation Support to Parliamentary Development in Pakistan ¿ Strengthened capacity for administration and support services

description.narrative:
The European Union is currently implementing a three-year project with the overall objective of supporting the consolidation of parliamentary democracy in the country. The purpose is sustainable institutional strengthening and operational and technical capacity for improved performance of the federal parliament (National Assembly and Senate, located in Islamabad) and of the provincial assemblies of Balochistan (in Quetta), Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (in Peshawar), Punjab (in Lahore) and Sindh (in Karachi). The present tender is intended to contribute to the result of ¿Strengthening the capacity of administration and support services¿. 

The purpose of the present tender is procurement of ICT equipment (and possibly related items) for the update/upgrade of the existing infrastructure of the Senate, National Assembly and the four Provincial Assemblies of Pakistan. It will also build capacities in operating and maintaining these supplies, as needed to achieve the goal of the overall programme. The tender will complement and support an existing service contract that pursues the programme objectives through technical assistance. The tender is divided into four lots: 1. E-parliament solution; 2. Conferencing solutions; 3. Resource centers upgrade; 4. Network and infrastructure.
